plan.description: Freeze lane, sample, blot, antibody, dilution, background, reference, replicate and uncertainty rules before intensities.
Admit immutable synthetic intensity rows; preserve saturation, range and background failures.
Check loading controls and blot references; collapse technical lanes before biological-unit uncertainty.
Preserve every exclusion and denominator; report bounded ratios, means, standard errors and intervals.
Register ordinary artifacts and separate claims for coordinator-owned independent review.
